lines.pinyin: yǒu méi wú xuě bù jīng shén
lines.cn: 只有梅花而没有雪花，显不出冬日梅花的傲骨神采
lines.en: Plum blossoms without snow lack spirited vitality,

lines.pinyin: yǒu xuě wú shī sú le rén
lines.cn: 有雪景而没有诗词咏叹，也会显得庸俗无味
lines.en: Snow without poetry turns one ordinary and mundane.

lines.pinyin: rì mù shī chéng tiān yòu xuě
lines.cn: 傍晚时分诗作刚刚写好，天空又飘起了雪花
lines.en: At dusk the poem is composed as fresh snow falls once more,

lines.pinyin: yǔ méi bìng zuò shí fēn chūn
lines.cn: 雪花与梅花相互辉映，共同酿造了十分浓郁的春色
lines.en: Joining together with the plum to create a perfect springtime.
